caption: Outer Banks wraps its 5-season run with the Pogues chasing a stolen artifact that could change everything. Plus: Lion tracks a real lion cub's 4-year journey from exile to pride king. Both streaming now. TV & Movie Pix
altText: Title slide reading: The end of one of Netflix's biggest shows. Outer Banks wraps its treasure hunt, plus a 4-year lion documentary debut.
Pull quote slide: Netflix's sun-soaked treasure-hunting series quickly became a fan-favorite in 2020. Attribution: Pix editors, on Outer Banks.

Body slide: Outer Banks returns for its final season, while a 4-year lion documentary tracks one cub's journey to kingship. The Pogues chase a stolen artifact in their last adventure. Kio the lion cub grows from outsider to pride leader in real time.
Stat slide: 4 years spent following lion cub Kio from outsider to pride king.
Moment slide: Chase Stokes and Madelyn Cline lead the Pogues as they chase a stolen artifact after losing one of their own.

Recommendation slide: Pix editors recommend Outer Banks on Netflix. Worth watching because the Pogues' final treasure hunt delivers stakes, loss, and fan-favorite drama.
